guidance.promptSnippet: Track multi-step work as a task list
promptGuidelines: `todo` holds the plan for work with 3 or more steps, a list of tasks from the user, or a sweep (one task per unit); single small tasks and conversation go without it. No plan or checklist files alongside it.

One task is in_progress at a time, set before you start it. A task is completed when it is done and its tests pass; partial work stays in_progress with a new task for the blocker. Example: {"action":"update","id":3,"status":"in_progress","activeForm":"writing tests"}.
